risks: First verify_handoff run failed (exit 1) on a genuine self-referential leak: the delivery manifest quoted the forbidden machine path in its own exclusion log. Fixed by redacting the marker and narrowing the scan; the final run passes, but any future edit that reintroduces a literal machine path into a shipped file will fail verification again by design.

Two test files are excluded from the zip (they hardcode this machine's absolute work-dir path), so the shipped test suite is 2 files short; full pytest must run from the source checkout, not from the unpacked zip.

The in-zip copy of DELIVERY_MANIFEST.json has archive_sha256 null by design (a file cannot hash its own archive); only the on-disk copy carries the zip hash. A recipient with only the zip can verify every file hash but not the archive's own hash.

The manifest commit matches HEAD only until the coordinator commits the T048 files; the packaging commit itself will move HEAD afterwards (recorded in DELIVERY_MANIFEST.json packaging_note, per D-R5-2). A later verify_release --manifest will report the by-design lag again until artifacts are rebuilt.

Installed-wheel --scenario export-format / research-correction demos still fail (pre-existing known gap, non-gating for J01); performance gate still FAILs; OFFLINE_RC scope only — none of this blocks the grade, but all of it blocks any public release.
